sounds.name: room-ambience
sounds.prompt: Quiet Japanese autumn night inside an old wooden tatami house: soft wind brushing paper shoji screens, distant bell crickets (suzumushi) chirping, an occasional faint wooden creak. Very calm and low. Seamless loop. No music, no voices.

sounds.name: candle-ignite
sounds.prompt: A single small candle wick catching flame: a soft whoosh and a gentle crackle, close and quiet.

sounds.name: candle-blow
sounds.prompt: Someone gently blows out a candle: a soft breath, the flame puffs out, a faint sizzle of the wick. Intimate and quiet.

sounds.name: furin-chime
sounds.prompt: A single Japanese glass wind chime (furin) rings softly once in a light breeze, delicate, with a short natural decay.

sounds.name: paper-turn
sounds.prompt: Turning a sheet of thick handmade Japanese washi paper, a soft close rustle.

sounds.name: flame-flare
sounds.prompt: A candle flame flares up with a low soft whoomp and crackle, then settles. Subtle and eerie, not loud.

sounds.name: temple-bell
sounds.prompt: A deep Japanese Buddhist temple bell (bonsho) struck once in the distance at night, long resonant decay, calm and solemn.

sounds.name: aoandon-arrival
sounds.prompt: A quiet supernatural presence arriving: a cold breath of wind and a low shimmering glassy drone that rises softly, faint distant airy whispers without words. No jump scare.

sounds.name: lantern-hum
sounds.prompt: A very soft, low, ethereal hum of a glowing paper lantern, gentle airy shimmer. Seamless loop, quiet.
